_comment: Combat action registry. Each entry: slot (key pressed), key (display label), id, name, short_desc (two short lines), type.

universal.name: Strike
universal.short_desc:
Standard attack.
STR + Prof vs enemy AC.

universal.name: Use Item
universal.short_desc:
Consume first usable
item in inventory.

universal.name: Flee
universal.short_desc:
Escape combat.
Costs 10% of max HP.

fighter.name: Cleave
fighter.short_desc:
Strike all enemies at once.
Disadvantage to-hit.

fighter.name: Second Wind
fighter.short_desc:
Self-heal 1d10 + CON mod.
Enemy still counter-attacks.

fighter.name: Defend
fighter.short_desc:
+AC (CON mod). If enemy
misses, riposte for free.

fighter.name: Battle Cry
fighter.short_desc:
Bellow a war cry. +STR mod
to all attacks for 2 turns.

mage.name: Arcane Bolt
mage.short_desc:
INT-based ranged attack.
Rolls initiative first.

mage.name: Mana Shield
mage.short_desc:
Conjure a damage barrier.
Enemy still attacks through.

mage.name: Evade
mage.short_desc:
DEX check DC 12. Success:
attack + foe at disadvantage.

mage.name: Arcane Surge
mage.short_desc:
Unleash all power: 3d6 damage,
no attack roll. Costs 1d6 HP.

monk.name: Flurry of Blows
monk.short_desc:
Two quick 1d4+DEX strikes.
Rolls initiative first.

monk.name: Iron Body
monk.short_desc:
+AC + WIS temp HP.
Fortify before enemy swings.

monk.name: Meditate
monk.short_desc:
Centre yourself. Enemy
attacks at disadvantage.

monk.name: Ki Strike
monk.short_desc:
Channel inner force: guaranteed
hit, WIS + STR bonus damage.

rogue.name: Backstab
rogue.short_desc:
Auto-advantage attack.
+1d6 sneak damage on hit.

rogue.name: Smoke Screen
rogue.short_desc:
Blind the enemy. No attack;
foe at disadvantage next round.

rogue.name: Poison Strike
rogue.short_desc:
Normal attack + 1d4 poison
damage on hit.

rogue.name: Shadow Step
rogue.short_desc:
Vanish and reappear behind foe.
Next hit is an automatic crit.

fallback.name: Power Strike
fallback.short_desc:
Disadvantage to-hit;
double damage dice on hit.

fallback.name: Evade
fallback.short_desc:
DEX check DC 12. Success:
attack + foe at disadvantage.

fallback.name: Defend
fallback.short_desc:
+AC (CON mod). If enemy
misses, riposte for free.
